title: English Practice Quiz 0898
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A travel itinerary usually lists ___.
questions.explanation: planned journeys, timings and destinations is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A confirmed ticket indicates ___.
options: a booking has been confirmed by the provider
questions.explanation: a booking has been confirmed by the provider is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A transit connection is ___.
options: a change from one service or route to another
questions.explanation: a change from one service or route to another is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If a train platform changes, passengers should ___.
options: check official announcements and follow station instructions
questions.explanation: check official announcements and follow station instructions is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A travel expense claim should include ___.
questions.explanation: eligible costs and supporting receipts is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A vehicle inspection before a journey can identify ___.
questions.explanation: visible defects or safety concerns is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A departure time is when a service is scheduled to ___.
questions.explanation: leave is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: If a journey is disrupted, travellers should ___.
options: seek updated information and follow provider guidance
questions.explanation: seek updated information and follow provider guidance is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A route diversion means ___.
options: the usual route has been changed
questions.explanation: the usual route has been changed is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.

questions.question: A travel allowance is generally ___.
options: an amount provided for eligible travel costs
questions.explanation: an amount provided for eligible travel costs is the correct answer based on the meaning and context of the question.
